title: Forward microstructure dataset
purpose: Collect causal public Binance USD-M microstructure observations for a later, separately authorized research experiment. This registration does not define a strategy, outcome, PnL, email, or trading release.

collectionBoundary.collectionStartAtPolicy: The collector must persist one explicit UTC timestamp before opening its first market-data connection. It is immutable for the run and is the lower bound for every accepted exchangeEventTime and localReceiveTime.

fixedUniverse.selection: Fixed before collection; no symbol may be added, removed, or selected from outcomes during this dataset.

transport.snapshotSource: REST depth snapshot paired with depth.diff; depth20 is retained as an independent raw stream and is never used to repair a diff-depth sequence.

rawRecord.rawPayloadPolicy: Retain the exact received payload without interpolation, coercion, forward-fill, gap-filling, or post-capture rewriting.
rawRecord.timestampPolicy: exchangeEventTime and localReceiveTime are preserved separately; localReceiveTime is recorded only after the complete WebSocket message or REST body is received.
rawRecord.symbolPolicy: Only the eight fixed symbols are accepted.

derivedSnapshots.causalInput: Only raw events with localReceiveTime at or before snapshotAt may be used.
derivedSnapshots.invalidBookPolicy: When the local diff-depth book is invalid, every depth-derived value is null and bookStateValid is false until a fresh valid snapshot and sequence are established.
derivedSnapshots.missingInputPolicy: Missing intervals remain missing; no forward-fill or synthetic snapshot is permitted.

largeTradeDefinition.input: aggTrade quote notional from the immediately prior 24 hours
largeTradeDefinition.warmup: Until a complete prior 24-hour window is available, threshold and large-trade fields are null.
largeTradeDefinition.minimumWindow: A complete 24-hour causal window must be explicitly evidenced; sparse or future-contaminated input is not accepted.

depthIntegrity.initialAlignment: The first applicable update must satisfy U <= snapshotLastUpdateId <= u; updates fully older than the snapshot may be recorded but are stale and not applied.
depthIntegrity.continuity: After alignment, pu must equal the previous final update id and update ranges must not skip ids.
depthIntegrity.resync: Mark bookStateValid=false, record the invalid segment, obtain a fresh REST snapshot, and restart alignment. Never silently repair or fill a gap.
depthIntegrity.featureSuppression: Depth-derived fields are null throughout every invalid interval.

clockAndLatency.overDriftPolicy: Latency-derived features are unusable while CLOCK_UNTRUSTED; raw timestamps remain immutable evidence.

dailyQuality.promotionRule: Any daily target failure blocks alpha research; the failed interval remains visible and is not repaired.

storage.collector: persistent Node.js process with a process supervisor; not a Vercel serverless function
storage.raw: Compressed JSONL or Parquet partitioned by UTC hour/day
storage.features: Supabase/Postgres 1s/5s/1m snapshots in a dedicated HY-DATA-0036 research schema/table
storage.manifest: Immutable SHA-256 manifest with file hash, row count, symbol, stream, UTC coverage, schemaVersion and provenance
storage.retention: Retain raw partitions and manifests for the full collection plus later authorized research retention; never overwrite a sealed partition
storage.capacityPlanning: Estimate from observed bytes per event for each stream, multiply by eight symbols and planned retention, and require headroom before activation.
